Stunning Restaurant In The Capella Hotel
Feb 2026 • Couples
The decor of this restaurant was fabulous. I can say I have never seen anything like it. 

We had our first night dinner here and breakfast every morning. Our dinner was great, steamed red grouper, wild grilled prawns in a a delicious sauce with glass noodles, vegetables served in an iron pot Bread was delicious as well as dessert.
Service was attentive and friendly. The atmosphere relaxing and quiet.

Breakfast each morning was very good. Fresh fruit buffet and omelets, French toast, and waffles off the menu. Coffee drinks were made fresh, lattes were our favorite.

This is a wonderful, beautiful place for dinner with so much to see throughout the restaurant.

Refined Northern Vietnamese Flavors
May 2026 • Friends
Backstage at the Capella Hotel in Hanoi, Vietnam, is a high-end restaurant recognized by Michelin, known for its theatrical, vibrant decor featuring Art Nouveau and Art Deco glamour reminiscent of The Great Gatsby. The space boasts dramatic, colorful, and luxurious designs inspired by theatrical costumes and murals, offering a stylish atmosphere. It specializes in refined Northern Vietnamese cuisine and provides attentive service.

We tried The Michelin Experience set menu, a 5-course culinary journey highlighting refined Northern Vietnamese flavors. It combines modern techniques with seasonal, local ingredients, presenting each dish as a work of art that enhances taste and flavor. We also sampled Vietnamese classics like charred, air-dried pork jowl, known for its tender texture and balanced flavors. Their version of traditional buncha was excellent as well.

My first trip to Hanoi & my first dinner.
Aug 2025 • Solo
I was spellbound by Backstage’s interior decor, ambiance, service and food. It was like time travel a blast back from the past. The furnishings were classy yet elegant, with a touch of posh and pieces of ensemble on display.

I was greeted with a warm & friendly waiter, Mr. Huy who introduced me to a trolley of Vietnamese pickles. He was informative and shared what & where to shop for souvenirs and memorabilia. 

The food was served warm, very flavorful and Instagram worthy. Thank you for delighting my tastebuds and a wonderful dinner.
